content.text: Bonanza Pai Gow is a casino variant of standard Chinese Pai Gow dominoes that adds two side bets â€” a Bonus bet and a Tie bet â€” alongside the traditional main wager. Played on a standard blackjack-sized table for up to 6 players, it uses Chinese dominoes, three dice, and chips. Bonanza Pai Gow was created by Gambology and copyrighted as a casino table game. It is a modification of traditional Chinese Pai Gow that adds Bonus and Tie side bets. The game was introduced at Crown Casino in Melbourne, Australia in January 2001.
1 to 6 players, each playing against the Banker (house or rotating player-banker).
Chinese domino set: 32 tiles arranged in 16 pairs. Each tile has a specific ranking in the Pai Gow system.
Chinese domino set. Three dice (for determining deal order). Blackjack-sized table with three betting circles per player: main bet (seat number), Bonus bet ('B'), and Tie bet ('T').
Tiles are shuffled and stacked. Three dice are rolled to determine dealing order. Each player and the banker receive 4 tiles.

items.text: Standard Chinese Pai Gow: The traditional game without Bonus or Tie side bets. Higher push rate (~40%). House edge reduced significantly when players bank.
